title: Exterior weight for influential low-degree subsets
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $\tau\in\mathbb{R}$. The sum of the squared Fourier coefficients of its real-valued version over sets outside the family of subsets of size at most $k$ contained in the coordinates with Boolean influence at least $\tau$ is at most the sum of squared Fourier coefficients over sets of size at most $k$ that are not contained in those coordinates, plus the sum over sets of size greater than $k$.
hypotheses_covered: sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
